"'''Kick the Ranat'''" was a [[Music/Legends|song]] performed as a hit single by [[The Palpatones]], a band formed by [[Greeata Jendowanian/Legends|Greeata Jendowanian]], [[Rystáll Sant/Legends|Rystáll Sant]], and [[Joh Yowza/Legends|Joh Yowza]] after the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]]<ref name="SWI 67" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY's]] [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Because of Jendowanian's beautiful voice, the band became an [[The galaxy/Legends|intergalactic]] sensation<ref name="SWI 67" />&mdash;also enjoying limited success in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Part 2">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-part-2|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref>&mdash;through "Kick the Ranat," before Sant left the band. The song shared its name with<ref name="SWI 67" /> the [[Ranat/Legends|Ranat]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="GG4-2">[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races'', Second Edition]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
"Kick the Ranat" was introduced in "[[Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band]]," an article [[Rich Handley]] wrote for the [[Star Wars Insider 67|sixty-seventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine,<ref name="SWI 67" /> which was published on [[April 15]], [[2003]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/03/news20030317.html|text=Celebrate <i>Jedi</i>'s 20th in ''Insider'' #67}}</ref> On [[January 21]], [[2014]], [[Edward M. Erdelac]] wrote "[[Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away]], Part 2," on [[StarWars.com]]. In that article, "Kick the Ranat" was again mentioned and was spelled as "Kick The Ranat."<ref name="SWI 67" /> This article assumes the original "Kick the Ranat" spelling from "Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band" is correct.
